decks.notes: This deck focuses on unleashing a rapid assault by quickly deploying cheap artifacts onto the battlefield and using them to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer, Frogmite, and Ichor Wellspring, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on. Additionally, cards like Galvanic Blast and Krark-Clan Shaman provide additional damage and control options. The deck also includes various mana-fixing artifacts like Chromatic Star to ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and versatile in order to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

Utilizing a combination of removal spells, card draw, and counterspells, this control deck aims to control the board while generating card advantage through recursion with Archaeomancer and Ephemerate. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while building towards a win condition by overwhelming them with value from cards like Mulldrifter and Lórien Revealed. With a mix of protection spells and removal, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a battle of attrition, ultimately achieving victory through card advantage and control.

This Aggro - Affinity deck focuses on quickly generating and utilizing artifact creatures to overwhelm the opponent. With efficient removal spells and card draw options, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. By utilizing artifact lands and synergistic card choices, the deck aims to deal damage swiftly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Galvanic Blast and Myr Enforcer showcase the deck's ability to quickly close out games through aggressive creature-based strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and creatures with disruptive abilities. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through cards like Augur of Bolas and Faerie Seer. The deck also includes a mix of card draw and card filtering spells to ensure consistency in drawing the necessary cards. With a strong mix of control elements and efficient threats like Ninja of the Deep Hours, Dimir Control aims to outlast and outmaneuver its opponents in a 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this Golgari Garden control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through sacrifice effects and card draw. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells, sacrifice outlets, and creatures with valuable abilities to outvalue the opponent over time. The key strategy is to maintain board control and card advantage through efficient removal and card draw, eventually overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats and recurring value. Additionally, the deck includes mana sources to support its game plan and ensure consistent performance.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Wild Growth, allowing for early aggression with powerful creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter. Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst provide disruption by destroying lands, while Skred can deal with problematic creatures. The deck also includes card draw with Llanowar Visionary and utilizes snow lands for synergy with Snow-Covered Forest and Snow-Covered Mountain. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient mana production and aggressive creatures.

Utilize a combination of sacrifice effects, card draw, and mana acceleration to swarm the battlefield with Goblin creatures and overwhelm your opponent with a quick and powerful assault. Use cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering to sacrifice your creatures for value, while also using cards like Ichor Wellspring and Chromatic Star for card draw. Take advantage of cards like Skirk Prospector for mana acceleration and unleash a flurry of Goblins onto the battlefield. The deck aims to quickly assemble a critical mass of Goblins to outpace and overpower the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost creatures in order to quickly build a strong board presence. The deck includes cards that allow for card advantage, protection, and removal to support the aggressive playstyle. Cards like Militia Bugler and Squadron Hawk provide card advantage, while Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands offer removal and protection. With a combination of efficient creatures and combat tricks, this deck aims to outpace the opponent and close out the game quickly through consistent pressure.

The deck focuses on utilizing flicker effects to repeatedly trigger enter-the-battlefield abilities of creatures like Mulldrifter and Sea Gate Oracle, while also using cards like Ephemerate and Ghostly Flicker for additional value. By controlling the board with counterspells like Prohibit and Remove Soul, and gaining card advantage with Deep Analysis and Preordain, the deck aims to out-value the opponent and eventually assemble a game-winning combo. The inclusion of God-Pharaoh's Faithful and Mortuary Mire provides some lifegain and recursion options to further solidify its game plan.

Focus on quickly assembling a board of low-cost artifact and creature cards to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks and burn spells. Utilize artifacts like Ancient Den and Great Furnace to power up cards like All That Glitters and Experimental Synthesizer. Use efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher to provide added value and card advantage. Support this strategy with burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt to remove threats and clear the way for your creatures to attack. Additionally, cards like Barbed Batterfist and Lembas provide additional support and utility to further enhance your aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap artifacts and creatures to quickly flood the board and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and synergy. By maximizing the use of artifacts, such as Springleaf Drum and Ornithopter, and buffing them with cards like All That Glitters, the deck aims to establish a fast and resilient board presence. Thoughtcast and Of One Mind provide card draw to maintain momentum, while Moon-Circuit Hacker can provide a powerful boost to the team. Metallic Rebuke offers disruption and protection, making it difficult for opponents to effectively deal with the aggressive threats.

The main focus of this Pauper 1 vs 1 Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards. Utilizing cards like Contaminated Aquifer and Tolarian Terror to control the battlefield, while Gurmag Angler and Murmuring Mystic provide win conditions. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Deep Analysis and Brainstorm to maintain tempo and outvalue the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through disruption and card advantage until it can establish a winning board state.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly swarm the board with cheap artifact creatures and use cards like Springleaf Drum and Metallic Rebuke to accelerate mana production and control the opponent's plays. By loading up these creatures with cards like All That Glitters and Moon-Circuit Hacker, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful attacks early on in the game. The inclusion of card draw spells like Thoughtcast and Of One Mind helps to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on generating value through sacrificing creatures and artifacts, with a strong control element using removal spells like Cast Down, Defile, and Snuff Out. It also includes cards like Ill-Gotten Inheritance and Crypt Rats for additional value and control. The inclusion of Khalni Garden and Troll of Khazad-dûm provides token generation to sacrifice, while cards like Tithing Blade and Ichor Wellspring help with card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to out-value opponents through efficient removal and creature sacrifice synergies.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with cards through cycling, then use Reaping the Graves to bring back multiple creatures, generating a large amount of value and potentially overwhelming your opponent. The deck also includes various ways to ramp up mana for big plays, such as Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, allowing you to combo off and quickly close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Architects of Will and Dihada's Ploy offer additional versatility and disruption to control the game against opponents.

This deck focuses on using counterspells, removal, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes cards like Thought Scour, Snuff Out, and Counterspell to manage threats while also leveraging the graveyard with Gurmag Angler and Deep Analysis. The inclusion of Tolarian Terror and Unexpected Fangs provides additional disruption, while Lórien Revealed and Murmuring Mystic offer win conditions through generating tokens. Overall, this Dimir Control deck aims to outsmart and outlast opponents by denying them resources and overpowering them with card advantage.
